what: On hover it tilts 3° around the bottom-right corner (.2s power3.out), then returns straight to place before the hover ends (.2s power3.in) — like poking a magazine cover on a shelf with a fingertip. Plays once each time it is lifted.

options.angle: Tilt angle (deg), default 3 — negative reverses it
options.back: Return duration (sec), same as default dur

note: The original drops the tilt tween at phone width (below 600px), so there is no motion. The part matches this by not attaching on devices without hover

from.where: index.js .pp-cover (magazine cover on the cover shelf — original mouseTriggerAnimation)
